Perform primary-ion matching against a direct target list

Source: R/method_DirectTargetMatch.R
PImatch_target.Rd

Matches feature table m/z values against a compound target list using [M+H]+ (positive mode) or [M-H]- (negative mode) ion m/z.

The target list is automatically normalised via normalize_target_list() before matching, so input data frames from different sources (HMDB, plate-based, PA14, etc.) are accepted without manual column renaming.

Usage

PImatch_target(object)

Arguments

object

A DirectTargetMatch object

Value

The same DirectTargetMatch object with @results populated
